# Orca DSH Launcher

> A Windows desktop companion and Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): update checking, server start/stop, system tray, WPF graphical console, and a one-click installation wizard.

Orca DSH Launcher is an open-source plugin and desktop toolset for DeepSeek Harness (also known as DSH or deepseek-harness), the open-source AI agent harness by DeepSeek. It helps DSH users manage their local DSH installation on Windows: it checks for official updates, controls the DSH web server, adds a system tray icon and a graphical management console, and can install DSH on a brand-new computer with one click.

## What it does

- Checks for DSH updates on every startup (query only - never auto-updates, never modifies DSH source)
- `/orca` slash command set: status, check, start, stop, restart, open, log, port, config, health/diagnose, console, tray
- System tray icon (WinForms NotifyIcon): left-click opens the UI, right-click menu starts/stops the server and checks updates
- WPF graphical console (Overview / Server / Install / Logs / Settings / About) with dark/light themes
- One-click installation wizard (orca-setup.exe) for installing DSH on a fresh machine: environment check, network check, git clone, pnpm install + build, plugin install
- Port ownership detection so it never kills unrelated Node processes
- Daily automatic update checks (notification only)

## Technologies

- Node.js / Cordis plugin (object plugin form, inject: ['commands'])
- PowerShell 5.1 (WPF console UI, WinForms tray, install and setup scripts)
- Windows platform only
- git, pnpm, npx @deepseek-ai/dsh

## Installation

Existing DSH users:
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1

Fresh machine: download orca-setup.exe from the Releases page and double-click it.

DSH official Web version (no plugin needed):
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
